descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-19 AI Check 2; TFA-92597 rule 11 · “A guessed unit on an ambiguous value (drip rate, lab, threshold) fails.”.

Bug B07 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was S0

The AI adds units nobody dictated: 'heparin at 14' becomes '14 units/hour', fluids 75 become '75 mL/hr', a bare weight 142 becomes '142 lb'

Tickets: TFA-94229 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: dev

Note: Bare temperatures are decision D2 2026-10-20 TFA-95204 run: one note wrote 'Temperature 38.1°F' for a dictated 38.1 (wrong unit).

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S10 AI Check 2: units — no guessed unit on ambiguous values, °C never °F, bare weight never pounds (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U17 AI Check 2: an unambiguous oral dose ('furosemide 40' → '40 mg') is fine; a guessed unit on an ambiguous value (drip rate, lab, threshold) fails; Celsius is never rendered as Fahrenheit; … (UAT TC-19 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; TFA-92597 R11; TFA-92597 comment 2026-09-25)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Ten dictations that carry a bare number where a unit is easy to guess: oral doses (allowed), drip rates, an insulin drip, a sliding-scale threshold, a lab, a bare temperature, a bare weight, a fluid rate

When Send each through the path the app uses for it (pre-round for vitals and described therapy, encounter for completed events)

Then An unambiguous oral dose may gain its standard unit; no drip rate, lab, threshold or fluid rate gains a unit; no temperature is shown in °F or converted; no weight is labelled pounds

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustNotInclude over rows and the pre-round output (vitals, cleaned notes, background, important points, course entry) per fixture, matched on word boundaries (' lb' and 'lbs', never a bare 'lb' that would match 'albumin' or 'albuterol'); 9/10 or better (3.2), every failure quoted. Whether 'kg' on a bare weight is a guess is Q12 (recorded, not judged); …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

The AI adds units the physician never said: 'heparin at 14' becomes '14 units/hour', fluids at 75 become '75 mL/hr' (also stored in the med row name), and a bare weight of 142 becomes '142 lb'.

Evidence: Allure bda7d839. Ledger #67 U67: Fail 6/10. Dev report §2 #6. This breaks TFA-92597 rule 11 (ready for qa). It is in the rest tier only because TFA-94229 is in progress.
